item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently imposes a binding 1972 import quota of 1,042.4 million pounds; the legal limitation occurs through this proclamation itself.","evidence":"the total quantity of the articles specified in item 106.10"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President makes the statutory economic-interest determination and presently suspends the proclaimed import limitation for 1972, directly altering the quota's legal operation.","evidence":"The limitation proclaimed in paragraph (1) is suspended during the calendar year 1972"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory necessity determination fixing the suspension's period, thereby supplying a legally consequential determination under section 2(d).","evidence":"It is hereby determined necessary that such suspension shall be for such period"}]}
